note: Forge's terminal tabs, checked headless: affrescoui_render_runner terminal.scenarios.json. The runner registers the terminal type without an executor, so no shell starts; these check the tabs, the panel and the nodes.

scenarios.name: terminal-hidden-until-one-opens
scenarios.note: No terminal at start: the panel has no Terminal tab and no terminal node

scenarios.name: terminal-new-shows-the-panel
scenarios.note: New Terminal opens the panel on its Terminal tab, with one terminal tab and its node

scenarios.name: terminal-two-then-kill-the-active
scenarios.note: A second terminal becomes the active one; killing it goes back to the first

scenarios.name: terminal-focus-opens-one-once
scenarios.note: Focus Terminal opens a terminal when there is none, and only shows the panel when there is one

scenarios.name: terminal-kill-the-last
scenarios.note: Killing the last terminal hides the Terminal tab: the panel goes back to Output
